source.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (COG, AWS Open Data)
source.nominalRes: 1 arc-second (~30.9 m N-S, ~27.2 m E-W at 28.1°N)
source.resampling: Catmull-Rom bicubic from the 1" lattice to the local metric grid

coarse.order: row-major, row 0 = north (z0), col 0 = west (x0); index = j*cols + i
coarse.sampleAt: x = x0 + i*cell, z = z0 + j*cell (sample locations, not cell centres)

fine.order: row-major, row 0 = north (z0), col 0 = west (x0); index = j*cols + i
fine.note: Catmull-Rom 3x upsample of the coarse grid. fine(3i,3j) === coarse(i,j) exactly. No information beyond 30 m.
